title: GTA6 Worldwide Unlock Times Revealed and Xbox NZ Trick
description: Grand Theft Auto 6 arrives November 19 on PS5 and Xbox Series X/S. Unlock times vary worldwide, and Xbox owners can seemingly use the old New Zealand trick.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA6 Worldwide Unlock Times and Platform Details

Grand Theft Auto 6 is officially scheduled to launch on **November 19** for **PlayStation 5** and **Xbox Series X/S**. As anticipation reaches a fever pitch across the global gaming community, details regarding how and when players will actually get to jump into the game are beginning to emerge.

According to recent reports from gaming media outlet Eurogamer, the exact moment you get to play GTA6 will vary depending on your geographical location around the world. Because the release is tied to regional timing, timezone differences will dictate the exact rollout of the game for eager fans.

## The Return of the New Zealand Trick for Xbox Owners?

An interesting detail highlighted in the coverage suggests that Xbox owners can seemingly still use the classic "New Zealand trick" to play the game early. By adjusting regional settings or utilizing accounts aligned with early-unlock timezones like New Zealand, Xbox Series X/S players have historically been able to bypass midnight local restrictions in their own regions.

While players await the definitive, official rollout schedule directly from Rockstar Games for all platforms, the prospect of getting a head start on Xbox hardware is certainly an exciting talking point for the community as the November 19 release date approaches.

## Editor's Take

The launch of GTA6 is a monumental moment for the gaming industry. Discussions around unlock times and regional tricks highlight just how eager the community is to dive in. Whether or not timezone workarounds pan out on launch day, managing your preload schedule will be essential for day-one readiness.
